highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 servicing work improves path bounds, clipping, and validation of serialized glyph replay data.
highlights_body: These collected m156 updates leave managed wrappers, generated bindings, and package versions unchanged.

bullets.detail: Upstream fixes correct Ganesh device-space path bounds and software coverage-mask subset clamping, plus Graphite clip-key packing and wedge miter bounds.

Slug replay validates positions, matrices, bounds, and flags, bounds direct-mask offsets, and preserves creation-time float rounding. Unsuitable glyph data retains rendering fallbacks, including when glyph-atlas bilinear filtering is unavailable.
